TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_competency
TABLE.COMMENT: The LTC competency framework, as declared in moodle/site/. Holds no user data. Rows are retired, never deleted.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency name, verbatim from competencies.yaml

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: Category key, verbatim from competencies.yaml

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based position across the whole framework

FIELD.NAME: retired
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once the competency is no longer declared

FIELD.NAME: slug
FIELD.COMMENT: The descriptor's frontmatter slug (spec 006, R3); names the competency pathway competency:slug. Unique among non-empty values, checked by apply

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: The competency's page on the published competency site (spec 006, R4); the host comes from mkdocs.yml, never from PHP

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_comp
TABLE.COMMENT: Which competencies each published course aims at, written by local_ltuse_set_course_competencies. Holds no user data.

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_badge
TABLE.COMMENT: Which badge is each published course's completion badge, written by local_ltuse_set_course_recognition (spec 013, R1). A badge has no idnumber, so this map is its identity. Holds no user data.

FIELD.NAME: imagehash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the template image the badge's image was made from; core resizes it, so the stored files cannot be compared

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_mentor_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: Message contacts local_ltuse made between a mentor and their learner (spec 003, research R5), so ending the relationship removes only those.

FIELD.NAME: mentorid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the mentor

FIELD.NAME: learnerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the learner

FIELD.NAME: contactid
FIELD.COMMENT: message_contacts.id of the contact this plugin made, so only that one is ever removed

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_org_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: Message contacts local_ltuse made between an organisation's manager and a person in it (spec 002 amendment 2026-10-02, research R12), so a leave removes only those.

FIELD.NAME: managerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the manager

FIELD.NAME: memberid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the person in their organisation

FIELD.NAME: contactid
FIELD.COMMENT: message_contacts.id of the contact this plugin made, so only that one is ever removed

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_booking
TABLE.COMMENT: Each office-hours booking's last notified time (spec 011, research R20), because core's calendar_event_updated carries no old time. One row per learner booking event.

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: event.id of the learner's SSstu: calendar event

FIELD.NAME: learnerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the learner who booked

FIELD.NAME: mentorid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the slot's teacher when the booking was made

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: the start as last notified

FIELD.NAME: timeduration
FIELD.COMMENT: the length in seconds as last notified

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_pathway
TABLE.COMMENT: Each published course's pathway facts (spec 006, R2), written only by local_ltuse_set_course_pathway. A pathway is computed from these at view time and never stored. Holds no user data.

FIELD.NAME: delivery
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the last publish was a delivery (stage 8); only then is the course in a pathway

FIELD.NAME: targetlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: The course's target_outcome_level, 1-4; 0 when it declares none

FIELD.NAME: pathwaykeys
FIELD.COMMENT: The pathway keys last announced for this course, so the next publish fires pathway_courses_changed for the difference

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_role_pathway
TABLE.COMMENT: Role pathways declared in moodle/site/pathways.yaml (spec 006, R5), written only by apply. Rows are retired, never deleted, so cohort assignments keep pointing at something. Holds no user data.

FIELD.NAME: rolekey
FIELD.COMMENT: The declared key; names the pathway role:rolekey

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Position in pathways.yaml

FIELD.NAME: retired
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once the role is no longer declared

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_role_pathway_comp
TABLE.COMMENT: Which competencies each role pathway names, in order (spec 006, R5), written only by apply. Holds no user data.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based position in the role's competencies

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_pathway_cohort
TABLE.COMMENT: A pathway assigned to a cohort (spec 006, R9); the seam with spec 008. usermodified is the only user data, declared by the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: pathwaykey
FIELD.COMMENT: competency:slug or role:key; resolved when assigned

FIELD.NAME: enrol
FIELD.COMMENT: Set to 1 only by spec 008; spec 006 never sets it or acts on it

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of who made or last changed the link; 0 after a privacy deletion

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_mentor
TABLE.COMMENT: Course mentors who are not a learner's default mentor (spec 008, research R10): one-course mentors (learnerid set) and the mentors of a cohort in a course (cohortid set). Exactly one of learnerid, cohortid is non-zero, and neither is ever NULL, so the unique index holds. The foreign keys on courseid and mentorid are their indexes.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: course.id of an ltct:slug course, never ltct:officehours

FIELD.NAME: mentorid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the course mentor, a member of ltct:mentors when recorded

FIELD.NAME: learnerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the learner for a one-course mentor; 0 when unused

FIELD.NAME: cohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: cohort.id for a cohort mentor; 0 when unused

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of who recorded it

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_protection
TABLE.COMMENT: Identity protection, one row per protected user (spec 016, research R5). Holds the real identity of a person at risk: learner data, Moodle only, never in the repo.

FIELD.NAME: ownlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: none, email, firstname or pseudonym: the level set for the user

FIELD.NAME: effectivelevel
FIELD.COMMENT: the level applied to the account; the same as ownlevel, since no organisation sets a minimum

FIELD.NAME: realfields
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON {field: {value, taken}}, each taken when that field first became withheld (R5)

FIELD.NAME: hidelogs
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the person asked for course logs to be blocked in the courses they take (R14)

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_protection_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Every change of a user's protection: who, when, from and to which level, and for a raise that the person asked and the email was checked (spec 016, FR-008). Moodle only.

FIELD.NAME: actorid
FIELD.COMMENT: who made the change; 0 once that person is deleted

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: own (a change of level) or correction (the same level, corrected values)

FIELD.NAME: requested
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the person asked for this change; required for a raise

FIELD.NAME: emailchecked
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the granter confirmed the account email identifies neither the person nor their organisation; required for a raise
